scenario: Compile-time regex syntax validation per LREG.7.1 — the compiler must parse every regex literal at compile time and reject syntax errors with the literal's source location. Pin: `/(unclosed/` (unclosed parenthesis) rejects with DS_VALIDATE_REGEX_SYNTAX_ERROR.
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    msg: String key

rule r:
    Log e where e.msg ~ /(unclosed/
->
    log info "matched"
